answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 45 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 12 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 45 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 540 bought sponsors, each risking real money. The forge of the design is public, the quill of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the zenith of honest work is what finally pays.
